sharedStateObservations.observation: The CaptureLogger pattern (thread_local + RefCell<Vec<String>> + std::sync::Once for log::set_logger) is a reusable test utility for verifying log output in Rust tests. This pattern avoids the one-time-only limitation of log::set_logger and works well for no_std crates that use `log` crate in library code but need `std` in test cfg. Could be documented in .factory/library/ for reuse across the project.
